notes.title: 𝐅𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐁𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠（1）
notes.notes:
⛺[b]Camp[/b]
The camp can restore health for heroes in a team.
If the main city is far away from the target place, you can build a camp during the march and dispatch the team through the camp

Tips: Level 5 is the highest level of the camp.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/e3893dcabe831024ec02b677246125535f6d1af0.png[/img]

If you want to dispatch more teams, you can upgrade your camp!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/faa3b11b40392b53ab8a8fac007b0c5ce8b7b7b6.png[/img]

🛡️[b]City Wall[/b]
The wall can block the enemy team's advance. When your team stands on the land with the wall, the wall will increase the team's defense.
After upgrading the city wall, you can increase the durability of the city wall and increase the defense bonus of the team. Therefore, building the city wall is necessary for every lord!

🗼[b]Crystal Tower[/b]
Crystal tower can automatically attack enemies that enter the territory within 1 square of the tower, causing spell damage to them.
When your team stands on the land with the crystal tower, the spell attack attribute will be improved. Upgrading the crystal tower can increase the spell damage and the spell attack bonus of the team.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/54e48c69cac6bce80324f95b2e4359a9dc8306fd.png[/img]

notes.title: 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞 𝐑𝐞𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭
notes.notes:
📈[b]Text Report[/b]
You won't believe how detailed the Legends of the Wild battle reports are!
Every turn's battle details, damage, and battle trends are all laid out for you to see.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/fcda8bebd96f19b44344d425b8d8e9a6a1ac176c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/546f4c1ca9a5fd25dfbf4045b34d092bcad863ec.jpg[/img]

🎥[b]Video Report[/b]
Don't want to read? Check the video report then.
After each battle, you can click the icon on the left side of the homepage to view the battle replay.
You can also filter the replays to view individual, alliance, attack, and defense reports~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/1bb8700a82941f6a8229ab24a90972d226d5aa1c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/9771c3653e56b154107b58d4d4ace3463da31c8e.png[/img]

notes.title: 𝐃𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐠𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐂𝐢𝐭𝐲
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/f21818f8a2ff561cbaa23ec80fef6bfabad8812f.jpg[/img]
Darkgold City is renowned for its steam mechanics and elemental technology. The hard ground beneath their feet, the mines, and the flames spewing from the machines are the sources of their confidence. They stand firm on the Elemental Continent with an unyielding posture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/3da97505b04207e9f5430eb16adcaa54f25059ae.png[/img]

notes.title: 𝐑𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐲 & 𝐇𝐮𝐧𝐭
notes.notes:
Rally not only offers abundant rewards but is also an important guild event. Let Vasha introduce you to more about it!
🛡️𝐆𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝/𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐑𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐲
First, the guild leader must use guild resources to build a Rally Stone, which exists for 24 hours.
The rallied squads for siege are divided into attackers and destructors. The attackers with higher strength required will engage in battles against the city guards.
Please select based on your strength."
Once a squad joins the gathering, it will immediately head to the gathering point at twice the normal speed without morale decrease. Upon arrival, the squads will enter a gathered state.
Captured cities provide various resource and facilitate the rapid deployment of troops.
Moreover, the guild leader can appoint players as lords of the cities, who can receive additional combat enhancement buffs.
Rally does not consume hero stamina; go ahead and conquer cities with allies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/a3577ecb258977023e84af88f657af77e8bea1e4.jpg[/img]

👾𝐇𝐮𝐧𝐭
Hunting targets randomly appear on the map, and every player can freely initiate a hunting rally, requiring 2 to 4 other members to join.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/db7022024802c629733b32469fc7ca2ef63d844e.png[/img]

The captain can set off once the team has more than 2 members. The more members participate in the hunt, the lower the difficulty will be. Vassa recommends a 5-team hunting~
Hunting rewards include forging materials and gold, which can be used for forging hero equipment and upgrading hero skills.
There's no stamina consumed or damage dealt for a rally event. The daily rally rewards times are limited, and equipment can only be acquired through forging, so be sure to actively participate!

notes.title: 📦𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐜𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
notes.notes:
In Legends of the Wild (LOTW), resources such as wood, stone, iron, food, and gold each play a distinct role in the construction of your main city.
As there are no resource packages available in the game, the question arises: how do we acquire these resources?

1️⃣𝐋𝐚𝐧𝐝
Land is the main source of resource output in the game.
Choose your target resource land on the map, send your troops to defeat the defending forces, then the land can be easily occupied.
Resources will stack up automatically post-occupation without manual collection.
In addition to acquiring resources, occupying land also expands your control area. The six tiles surrounding the occupied land will be at your disposal.
Let's conquer further lands!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/e5de66d6a016d0045df90f4933580e1e7d3c9e50.png[/img]

2️⃣𝐁𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠
Constructing resource buildings on occupied land can further increase resource output!
Food Statue - Increase the Food output of the corresponding tile.
Wood Statue - Increase the Wood output of the corresponding tile.
Iron Statue - Increase the Iron output of the corresponding tile.
Stone Statue - Increase the Stone output of the corresponding tile.
Gold Statue - Increase the Gold output of the corresponding tile.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/bdad50492e4f8e4ad76c57f930a9bc199b4bdeb6.png[/img]

3️⃣𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐠𝐲
Using resources to upgrade technology can enhance resource output efficiency (Is Vassa saying a tongue twister...? (´ﾟдﾟ`)
Anyway! Players can visit the Town Hall to level up various tech to develop the City and improve combat strength.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/8d76656bdc8f7cf4559e1a7f5288e52aa5225fea.png[/img]

Of course, in addition to these methods, resources can also be obtained through quests, item exchanges, and more for you to discover~
Remember, a wise Lord masters the art of resource management!

⚔️𝐸𝑛𝑗𝑜𝑦 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝑓𝑢𝑛 𝑜𝑓 𝑓𝑖𝑔ℎ𝑡𝑖𝑛𝑔!

notes.title: 𝐋𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞
notes.notes:
Repeatedly developing heroes is not only boring, but you may also regret developing heroes that do not meet your purpose.
In the early stages of the game,  you can use "Level Resonance" to easily develop heroes because all heroes share the same level. As long as one hero is upgraded, all heroes will gain the same level experience and reach the same level. 

You don't need to worry about tedious resource allocation!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/e759be60c56a07c78c81a0763c80734b921dbd08.png[/img]

notes.title: 𝐒𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐥
notes.notes:
1️⃣𝐀𝐜𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
Of course, recruitment!
🤫Vassa tell you a secret, sometimes you can get rare skills in the Travel event.

2️⃣𝐁𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐚𝐥
Besides two general skills, each hero can be equipped with two additional skills. These additional skills are flexible; you can remove them at any time and mix and match to suit your strategy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/cebaaf98d2ccff320725b44e458f4d98e2c3aed3.png[/img]

3️⃣𝐔𝐩𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐞
Upgrading skills requires gold.
It returns 80% of the gold coins spent when you reset or remove upgraded skills. So please plan your gold use reasonably.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/9da63f1ddf484262c3765548e236f3cb90549f6c.png[/img]

4️⃣𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
The skill converts into shards automatically when you get the same one.
Skill shards can be used to promote the corresponding skill.
Promoting a skill significantly enhances its effects.
Each skill can be promoted up to 5 times.
Once a skill has been promoted 5 times, any additional skill shards can be dismantled to receive Exchange Points.
Exchange Points can be redeemed for skill shards in the Promotion Store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/e1efdabb096622f99a6f6be936a2899a716e3a2b.png[/img]

5️⃣𝐀𝐬𝐜𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧
When you obtain the same skill with higher rarity, you can use skill ascension.
After skill ascension, the resources spent on upgrading the original skill will be returned.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/bebd6f7b03e02fb44baeda1dff1218e85683fe08.png[/img]

You can form any trio of heroes into a troop, just like in those RPG games.
It can be traditional with a warrior, mage, and support, a classic adventure team!
Of course, you can also be innovative, with three tanks or three mages? Create your own combo!
Skills are also crucial for enhancing the troop's combat strength.
They are completely flexible—no unlock fees required!
Why not have a warrior casting magic balls if you wish?

💡𝑁𝑜𝑤, 𝑐𝑎𝑝𝑡𝑢𝑟𝑒 𝑙𝑎𝑛𝑑 𝑡𝑜 𝑡𝑒𝑠𝑡 𝑦𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑠𝑡𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑔𝑖𝑒𝑠!

notes.title: 𝐓𝐨𝐰𝐧
notes.notes:
Upgrading the Town hall improves the Town's durability. If your town is defeated, and its durability is consumed to 0, it will return to its birthplace. Don't worry, you won't lose any resources or gold.
Meanwhile, the winner gains more territory and advances to the front.
The shield only lasts 3 hours (with more than 24hs cooldown).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/e6b2e4cc80eef87660fb681292309e15e5776ec4.png[/img]

[b]𝐓𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭[/b]
"There's no teleport item in LOTW. Players cannot teleport their base freely. It requires some preparation and is not unlimited. So, no need to worry about night raids.
Let's see how can we teleport."
Occupy a piece of land in the resource state, then you can build a Teleport base. This allows you to seize more fertile lands and gain higher resource yields!
The building of a Teleport Base takes one hour, with a cooldown time of 12 hours, and each Teleport Base can only be used once. Please make a plan ahead.
Before teleporting, coordinate closely with your allies to synchronize operations. This will enable swift assembly with the alliance's main force, enhancing teamwork efficiency.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/eaa71ff08851cf5dbd52e16e2c1ff8de5fe02008.png[/img]

👊 Strategy defines destiny. Your choices forge the legacy on the Elemental Continent.

⚔️𝐸𝑛𝑗𝑜𝑦 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝑓𝑢𝑛 𝑜𝑓 𝑓𝑖𝑔ℎ𝑡𝑖𝑛𝑔!

notes.title: 𝐒𝐪𝐮𝐚𝐝
notes.notes:
❤️𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐡
The squad cannot march out of the Town when the Captain's Health is 0. Let's take a look at how health is restored.

1️⃣Fountain of Life
The most direct way is the Fountain of Life. It automatically consumes Food to replenish Health. 
By consuming additional Food, you can activate the Rapid Replenish for the Fountain of Life. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/e13377fe42b3adb07c868104741d2b92c3d1fdef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/edc354f7452d7f680f5fa94d1c977614165e3d27.png[/img]

2️⃣Medkit
You can use resources（iron, wood, gold） to heal the squads within the Town.
The treatment provided by Medkit will directly affect the squads without impacting the storage of the Fountain of Life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/276a91f89aa4a10ca30027e0f4bbdf3c6d05318f.png[/img]
Please reasonably choose the Health recovery status according to your current needs.

💪𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐥𝐞
Morale affects the squad damage.
The morale will reduce by 1 for every tile the squad moves. 1 morale will be restored for every 2 minutes the squad stays.
A squad has 100 morale by default when leaving the Town.
When a squad returns to the Town, its morale will be fully restored immediately. Standing by while outside the Town can also slowly recover morale over time.
To enhance a squad's chances of victory, it's crucial to take the squad's morale into account when they depart from the city for battle.

🥇𝐑𝐚𝐧𝐤
How to level up heroes without EXP items?
1️⃣Land
Every piece of land on the map can be conquered, and the squad can gain EXP regardless of failure or victory.
Occupied territory can be exploited. Heroes receive EXP and the territory will enter the Rapid Exploit, increasing the output by 100% for 24 hours.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/6c55fd6312f6e4394ff7dc40e84ca62b8c94cb31.gif[/img]

2️⃣Ruins Exploration
Defeat the stage guards and the Ruins Keeper to progress to the next stage.
Higher Ruins stage levels result in faster EXP collection by the Orb. So increase the level of it to speed up the exp collection!"
The EXP Orb collects EXP automatically every hour, which can be allocated to boost a hero's EXP quickly.
The Ruins Exploration does not consume stamina and true health. Please feel free to challenge it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/315d423f64575de821ccf2f2965725503db18df7.png[/img]

3️⃣Training Ground
The stamina cost, and battle progress in the training ground are exactly the same as the land occupation/exploitation. But it can save a lot of time. Improves the efficiency of training.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/f07b6511629897fa6ad0ccf8190e359f0b2b4e61.jpg[/img]

4️⃣Statue
You can use Strategy Scrolls to destroy statues for rich EXP and rewards.
Bravely challenge the hero statue and break it to prove your power!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/c481040b0ecfb4e14fe9556df8136f4bece6b3b2.png[/img]

⚔️𝐸𝑛𝑗𝑜𝑦 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝑓𝑢𝑛 𝑜𝑓 𝑓𝑖𝑔ℎ𝑡𝑖𝑛𝑔!

notes.title: Technology
notes.notes:
Upgrading technology can increase resource output and improve the power of heroes. It is the only way for every  lord to become stronger.
In LOTW, the time for all building and technology upgrades is 0. 

[b]No need to wait,
No need to pay for speed-ups.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/62a620bcfac0ed4b80209c2afb37967983cae4af.gif[/img]

notes.title: Frame
notes.notes:
The Frame has different levels, each level has different privileges (increased territory limit, improved hero speed, etc.). 

You can receive a weekly reward chest based on your frame level once a week.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/526c146d5a0e998a37de70b3be7fc1d6c080defd.png[/img]


[b]There're different types of Frame[/b]

1️⃣  Territory Frame Points
Obtained through occupying land, upgrading the Reclamation land, and building.

2️⃣  Glory Frame Points 
Obtained through attacking against rival city lords.

3️⃣  Siege Frame Points
Obtained through occupying tiles, defeating opponent Governor's squads, occupying cities, destroying Hero Statues, and constructing cities.

4️⃣  Destroy Frame Points
Obtained through destroying Hero Statues.

5️⃣  Construction Frame Points
Obtained through upgrading levels of the Town Hall and Tech research. 

⚔️𝐸𝑛𝑗𝑜𝑦 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝑓𝑢𝑛 𝑜𝑓 𝑓𝑖𝑔ℎ𝑡𝑖𝑛𝑔!

notes.title: Producer Letter
notes.notes:
Hi dear gamers! I'm Ronnie, the producer of Legends of the Wild (LOTW).

As a game geek, I've always been a huge fan of RPGs and strategy games, especially the strategy game 4X type（4X refers to Expand, Explore, Exploit, and Exterminate) . With the rise of mobile gaming and the MMO element, 4X strategy games have found a new lease on life.
Cooperate with allies in battle and ultimately achieve victory! Everything was so exciting!

It's been a decade since I first got into mobile strategy games. The countless hours and resources I've invested have been rewarded with unforgettable memories. I miss every ally, every night we gathered, every dawn we launched raids, and the unyielding spirit of Victory.

Despite playing numerous strategy games, I couldn't find the most perfect one. Therefore, I decided to make my own game ——Legends of the Wild (LOTW).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/03a9b246b69d5b9918baab90013904a836a11dd4.jpg[/img]

1️⃣ [b]Free to Play, but not Pay to Win. I want fair competition[/b]
We can't deny that the continuous operation of a fair F2P game requires the payments of whales,
but fighting between a 100M power and a 10K power is really boring. Normal players have no chance against the whales. 
But I believe EVERY PLAYER MATTERS!
I aim to develop a strategy game in which f2p players and small spenders can genuinely compete with whales and have a shot at victory. Here, respect is earned through skill and strategy, not spending.

In LOTW, we've removed direct purchase packages (heroes, resources, and boosts), making resources earnable only through gameplay - capturing land or upgrading technology (just like gold in League of Legends and Dota 2, which you can only get by killing minions and monsters). Heroes have level caps, so there's a limit to how strong a troop can be. Recovery of the troop's HP loss takes time, not power recovery items. Both sides face consequences, maintaining fairness.

So, do paying players have no advantages at all?
Not really. We believe paying players should get some benefits, but the numerical advantages should be limited, focusing more on enhancing playability. I'll talk more about that in the next point.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/915af7a504e9884fc19a3ee508351fdbc37e22b0.png[/img]

2️⃣[b]PVP should focus on enjoyable strategy, not numbers. It's about fun, not just power comparison[/b]
In LOTW, every PVE and PVP battle is a 3v3 turn-based combat with heroes. Each hero has 2 unique skills and 2 skill slots that players can freely combine.
——You can give a healer skill to a mage, turning him into a support. You can also equip him with 2 auxiliary skills to make him an auxiliary.
——That's right. You can also give him damage reduction and physical attack skills, such as turning a mage into a tank or a warrior (though he might not be very strong).

Victory hinges on the strategic combination of heroes, skills, counterplay dynamics, and a dash of luck, not just on spending money.
As for spenders' advantages, which I mentioned in point 1 are numerically limited:
① Paying players can draw more heroes and skills, so they have more combinations to try than normal players. 
② With this variety, whales might be able to manage 4-5 teams at the same time, but normal players can only play 1-2 teams. (But these teams will consume the same amount of game resources, such as health recovery resources.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/1e57b7364eb60af40e230e0be2dc79238511f02b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/65df98bdc028b4f23258b1e61ab8fec4d7436a44.gif[/img]

3️⃣ [b]No boring waiting[/b]
In strategy games, power growth is an enjoyable part, but waiting is annoying.
Whales can speed up city and tech upgrades through payments, creating a significant advantage over f2p and low-spending players, and deriving greater satisfaction from the game. Of course, this is also a very important part of the game company's revenue.

After playing numerous strategy games, what thrills me the most is the GvG experience with allies post-basic city/tech upgrades. So we've removed the time-consuming of all building and tech upgrades, along with paid acceleration options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/62a620bcfac0ed4b80209c2afb37967983cae4af.gif[/img]

4️⃣ [b]No boring world map gameplay[/b]
Each player has a castle, they teleport to targets, engage in combat, and then teleport away. While the initial experience is thrilling, it becomes monotonous over time.
To safeguard my castle when I'm not online, I have to keep the [protection shield] active. Can we make the world map gameplay more realistic and interesting?

When I'm safely behind the front lines with allies shielding me, enemies shouldn't be able to [Flash] right up to my face for an attack, should they? The mountains and rivers on the map shouldn't just be decorations, can they provide real strategy/fun?

In LOTW, we offer real terrain gameplay.
Mountains and rivers will obstruct movement, allowing guilds to strategically place defenses or plan attacks using the landscape. When I'm well behind the front lines or our defenses are robust, I'm secure and don't need to activate the "protection shield" constantly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/f0f03164101057ab8bd0efe76f162b3526beea37.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/ac35943e5624abd6375c768ab7f074fce9150719.png[/img]

5️⃣ [b]The battle is over! Let's start another one! [/b]
In strategy games, after battling alongside allies and experiencing the thrill of victory (sometimes defeat).
At this time, we desperately want to do it again and enjoy such a fun process (with new content and new opponents).
However, traditional strategy mobile games often only provide 1-2 cross-server events per month (lasting a few hours or days), which leaves us wanting more. But starting anew on a different server with a new account makes it difficult to let go of the characters we've invested so much time, emotion, and money into.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/430766dd780a1a3b0ca5338fb8c88bcd17a34481.png[/img]

Can there be a better mechanism to let us start over? 
💡 We made a seasonal system!

In LOTW, a season is about 40-60 days. 

Players fight for their own factions. The faction that ultimately occupies the heart of the world wins. Members of the winning faction will get more rewards while the losing faction will also get some rewards.
Then, after the season settlement, players will enter the second season after a few days of matching.
In the new season, you will meet new opponents and new teammates (your allies in season 1 will definitely match together). The new season will also provide new gameplay and mechanisms.
At the start of each new season, all paid-related data remains intact (heroes, skills, appearance, etc.), while growth-related data is reset (city level, tech level, hero level, skill level, guild level, and remaining tech advancements)
Just like in League of Legends and Dota 2, you just won an epic victory, your hero and skin will be retained, and your hero proficiency will grow, but your level, equipment, and skill level cannot be brought into the next battle.

Start a new adventure with your allies! Team up, take on challenging foes, and strive to conquer the continent together!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/eb077afb748f960dc7619cc33ef1106c0666aa26.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/16978447ebdc3c67760c57964d5d68dd5a68db93.png[/img]

I've shared a lot, I'm very excited to have the opportunity to bring you Legends of the Wild--it's so different. 
At the same time, I'm also very nervous. In LOTW, we've made a lot of innovations, which come with both opportunities and risks, as well as the challenge of player adoption. However, we think these changes and innovations are what I (and hopefully you) want as players. So I hope you can give us a chance!
To quote the movie Ready Player One —— Thank you for playing my game!❤️ 

I look forward to Legends of the Wild bringing you a great experience.
Sincerely,
Ronnie

notes.title: Brief Game Flow of LOTW
notes.notes:
Recruit animal heroes, understand their attributes and create your own team.
Conquer land with your allies, make rational use of all resources on the continent, and defeat enemies from other camps.

After entering the game, you need to choose your faction    
✨𝑅𝑎𝑑𝑖𝑎𝑛𝑡 𝐾𝑖𝑛𝑔𝑑𝑜𝑚

All players in the faction are your teammates. You don't have to worry about being attacked. 
🔥Enjoy the excitement of conquer and fighting the dragon with your allies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/1b5e04b694a030c31c30006588c8fbfdf184d28b.jpg[/img]

At the beginning, develop your base is your primary goal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/4c067555ade11cbcaf283775054d397996ee9d62.jpg[/img]

[b]We do not sell resource packages. 
Occupying land is the main way to obtain resources.[/b]
After defeating the land defenders, you need to wait for a while to occupy it. It  can be accelerated for free during the novice period.
After the occupation is completed, the land will automatically produce resources, and there is no need to collect them regularly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/90f8bf83098c199d75b12c574f19ff3d02a88eba.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/e89793a3132782926308178a8344567c6c858d4c.png[/img]
Within the blue and green control zones on the map, you and your allies can freely conquer resource lands. When you occupy a piece of land, your control zone will also be expanded.
Taking a city can expand a larger area near the city into a faction control zone, making it easier for allies to quickly mobilize their teams.

[b]The larger the control zone, the freer the conquest!    [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/2bc68afa1242bb1b2601f526fa900231721d327c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/e3eb6ccc1883d17631e4b69fe13b7d6891ee3272.png[/img]

Use your resources to upgrade buildings and technologies to unlock more gameplay.
💡 [b]You don't need to wait or pay to upgrade any building technology, it can be completed in one second. [/b]   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/62a620bcfac0ed4b80209c2afb37967983cae4af.gif[/img]

Use recruitment tickets to get heroes, each team includes three heroes.
You can freely combine heroes and skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/1d977668851c5b792a5663d9a15e417197eb9fe6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/3755a193d322738b0ac6b3ef7c8367bc4ef2fc6f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/bebd6f7b03e02fb44baeda1dff1218e85683fe08.png[/img]

Level resonance system, hero replacement system, and reset system will help improve your team. 
You don't need to repeatedly strengthen heroes or worry about wasting resources.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/7d5fd1bdfe60e32b2ed6517591c4fc9aabaf520b.png[/img]

To secure the final victory, lords from across the continent will gather to form various guilds.
You can choose to join them or build your own.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/6a2ff4bfb864e3abf5eba7867b78a248f09e6c2c.png[/img]

The strongest guild leader will become the monarch of the faction, using the power to command all faction players.
⚔️ Monarch can issue faction orders, summon giant beasts to assist in city sieges and use buff to strengthen the whole army.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/6f686d26ae3cc838978abd1168fe3e3581b2ee98.png[/img]

You can flexibly match the heroes in your team and win in different ways, such as killing the enemy captain, controlling the opponent's AD, or counterattacking the opponent's damage.

Strategies are very important. You can choose to sneak attack the enemy and win with one strike.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/f7a6f52f085887f80abe0b89f37bdfa7fa80aff6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/a1620cc473e774b450702aabcef7221fc28f08df.gif[/img]

While actively attacking, it is also importance to defend well.

Surround the mountains for defense, occupy bridges to block traffic, the terrain is your best helper!
Don't forget about building technology! Build walls for defense, magic towers to deal damage to incoming enemies. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/b914c390ee642b36ed6314a3bb1b68ee24dae0d0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/3879f017c807b210c27f105175705b201752bae8.png[/img]

In LOTW, you will be rewarded with a certain amount of honor points regardless of win or loss. You can use it to buy various items and resources. 

 💡[b]Even if your city is attacked or captured, you will not lose resources or money.[/b]
Your city will automatically move to the original birth region, and you can wait for the opportunity to come back!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/46bd31a9b3e78132b8f16f3ba34f91fe992dca8c.png[/img]

The hero's lost health needs to consume life fountain water for treatment and the fountain water will slowly accumulate over time.
[b]No resources or speed-up packs in game[/b], so there is no need to worry about raids from whales. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/78a50a07830e311dbd5012f10334a3a9e139838b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/3694d88966cfe768be91147c1e7dbee15956ba18.png[/img]

After 30 to 45 days of fierce fighting, the strongest faction will break through the difficulties and gather at the Heart of the World.
Under the command of the monarch, you will finally occupy the Heart of the World.
At the end of the season, we will rank the factions based on their city points and personal reputation. 

Base on the ranking, the system will send generous rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512075/1a802cd5774b432d028b4f8c8d9a3b1b314189e2.png[/img]

After the season ends, players will enter a new season at the announced time.
In the new season, you will be matched with your old friends and face new challenges. 
Strong enemies from other servers may become your opponents in the new season.
We will also provide new gameplay: new maps, new heroes, new game play, etc.

💡At the same time, in order for everyone to enjoy a fair battle, we will reset some game progress
[b]Your heroes, skills, skins, gears, game items will be retained,
but your city level, hero level, skill level, city construction technology level will be reset,[/b]
which just like you start the next game after a moba game.
